$comment: FORM P5-T9c admission, written 2026-11-18 (owner decision option A): the top-level appShell + guidePages became ONE optional ROOT `backOffice` {defaultRoute, navigation, pages}, independent of experiences and roles (experiences[].backOffice stays a boolean link). Same menu/page entries, so the net budget change is +1 slot (3 backOffice.* and pack:backOffice in; appShell.defaultRoute, appShell.navigation and pack:guidePages out).

declarative.why: names the concept/panel the back office opens on, the menu entries (label, target, group) and the dashboard pages (regions, theme, gadgets bound to queries); no ordering of steps, no logic; omitted entirely, the shell keeps its derived defaults

notLower.why: the menu and the dashboard layout are structure the generated shell renders; no expression, function or step can say which entry opens first or which gadget sits in which region -- and a pack needs a place to contribute its own dashboard pages that survives composition (qualified pack::Page names)

twice.note: defaultRoute, navigation and pages: both apps declare all three (dsl-conformance-max and pigmentampas, each a root `backOffice`; WmsOffice and simple-user-registry-h2local use pages too). pack:backOffice: the labeling pack (NPDevSamples/dsl-conformance-max/Input/packs/labeling, and its copies in pack9-role-binding-a/b)

enforced.note: tests, not a booted probe: BusinessUiEmitterAppShellManifestTest and BusinessUiEmitterGuidePageManifestTest fail if defaultRoute/navigation/pages stop reaching the generated UI manifest; NPDevContract/dsl BackOfficeConfigThreadingTest fails if the menu, the page order, the one-menu rule, the pack-qualified page names (labeling::LabelingOverview) or the composed-model round trip break; AppShellModelThreadingTest rejects a navigation target or defaultRoute that names nothing

taught.bundleLine: `backOffice` (OPTIONAL root key -- omit it unless you want a grouped menu or your own dashboards): `{"defaultRoute":"<Concept>","navigation":[{"label":"..","target":"<Concept>","group":".."}],"pages":[<guide pages>]}`
